brief.object: A classic yellow rubber duck facing the front (-y), round head on top of a rounded body, beak forward and tail up at the back.
features: Bold flat orange beak sticking forward from the face
Big black eyes on the front/sides of the head, two studs wide
Upturned pointed tail at the back of the body
Round head and body with sloped, sleek shoulders; a little blue bow tie at the neck under the beak
brief.plan: Keep the converted head and body volumes (they carry the round proportions). Rebuild the beak as a clean, solid orange block anchored two studs into the face, with a tiled top. Replace the tiny one-cell eyes on the top surface with 2x4 black patches on the face where the seed has them. Add a raised tail at the back so the side silhouette reads as a duck. Make the surface sleek with slopes at steps and a tiled crown. A small blue bow tie is painted into the front of the neck below the beak: taller wings at the ends, a narrower knot in the middle.
brief.finish: Sloped everywhere the round head and body step in, tiles on the flat crown and beak, since a rubber duck is smooth and glossy.
